2609.19906.title: Learning and Transferring Closed-Loop Robot Software
2609.19906.paper_summary: Closed-loop robot policies require observation processing, state management, and situation-dependent branching, making them costly to design and tune manually. Although coding agents increasingly support control-code generation and optimization, it remains unclear whether implementations improved on source tasks also support policy acquisition for new tasks. We study this question by treating complete closed-loop implementations as reusable execution experience. For each source task, a coding agent generates policy code from a few successful demonstrations and iteratively improves it using simulation feedback. The validation-selected implementations are retained in a software archive. For new tasks, the agent generates and improves policies using archived implementations, target demonstrations, and execution feedback. The resulting policy is then frozen and executes without further model calls. Across four source tasks in RoboCasa, iterative optimization increases mean success from 28.3% to 64.2%. Across nine target tasks and three independent runs, mean success is 45.2% without references, 41.5% with initial source code, and 57.0% with optimized source code. Optimized references outperform initial references in all three runs on the nine-task average, with a mean gain of 15.6 percentage points. These results demonstrate the value of execution-improved software as a resource for acquiring new policies in this setting, although initial references remain better on two target tasks when averaged across runs.
2609.19906.paper_summary_zh: 封閉迴路機器人策略需要觀察處理、狀態管理和依情境分支，使得手動設計和調整成本高昂。儘管編碼代理越來越支持控制代碼的生成和優化，但尚不清楚是否在源任務上改進的實現也支持新任務的策略獲取。我們通過將完整的封閉迴路實現視為可重用的執行經驗來研究這個問題。對於每個源任務，編碼代理從幾個成功的示範中生成策略代碼，並利用模擬反饋進行迭代改進。經過驗證選擇的實現被保留在軟體檔案庫中。對於新任務，代理使用存檔的實現、目標示範和執行反饋生成和改進策略。生成的策略隨後被凍結並執行，而不需要進一步的模型調用。在 RoboCasa 的四個源任務中，迭代優化將平均成功率從 28.3% 提高到 64.2%。在九個目標任務和三次獨立運行中，平均成功率在沒有參考的情況下為 45.2%，使用初始源代碼為 41.5%，使用優化源代碼為 57.0%。在九個任務的平均值中，優化參考在三次運行中均優於初始參考，平均增益為 15.6 個百分點。這些結果顯示了執行改進的軟體在此環境中作為獲取新策略的資源的價值，儘管在平均運行中，初始參考在兩個目標任務上仍然表現更佳。
2609.19906.author: So Kuroki et.al.
